payload.claim: The docstring says the push 'refuses when the outcome's own row, or another row at `READY_FOR_REVIEW`, `CHANGES_REQUESTED`, `APPROVED`, `REBUTTAL_UNJUDGED` or `EXHAUSTED`, already carries a pull request,' implying all five states are gated on carrying a pull request. The code at lines 1203-1211 only checks `pr_url` for the latter four; a `READY_FOR_REVIEW` row refuses unconditionally, with no `pr_url` check at all (same as the pre-existing, untouched branch of the guard). The rewritten sentence is less precise than the text it replaced, which stated the two conditions separately.
